decision.summary: A transient negative U-excursion (535–550) with minor E coupling is observed; the absence of a clear return before index 550 and lack of recovery within the allowed context prevent confirmation of a complete temporary offset. N-component shows no significant response. No other temporary offsets are supported in [500,585].

intervals.observation: U-component shows a multi-sample negative excursion (down to ~-5 MAD) centered near index 540, with a preceding small positive spike; E-component exhibits a modest concurrent dip; N-component remains quiet. No return to pre-excursion baseline is observed within allowed context [500,585].
